message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify` (`vendor/slugify/index.js`), which deletes any character outside `a-z0-9`, accented letters included. That file is marked "do not edit by hand", so I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js`. There, `postSlug` now decomposes the title (`normalize('NFD')`) and strips the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) use the same vendored function, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone to keep the change focused. The same one-line normalization would fix them if you want it.
